title: Add FAQ Accordion
content: Create FAQ component. Container: max-w-2xl mx-auto. Section header: text-center mb-8, title text-3xl font-bold, subtitle. Questions: divide-y border rounded-lg. Item: py-4 px-6. Question button: w-full flex justify-between items-center text-left font-medium, chevron icon rotates on open. Answer: text-gray-600 pt-4, hidden when collapsed, animate height on toggle.

variants.simple: Create FAQ section with expandable question/answer pairs.
variants.detailed: Create FAQ component. Container: max-w-2xl mx-auto. Section header: text-center mb-8, title text-3xl font-bold, subtitle. Questions: divide-y border rounded-lg. Item: py-4 px-6. Question button: w-full flex justify-between items-center text-left font-medium, chevron icon rotates on open. Answer: text-gray-600 pt-4, hidden when collapsed, animate height on toggle.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive FAQ section. Layout options: single column, two columns, or categorized with tabs/sections. Search: filter FAQs by keyword, highlight matches in questions. Categories: group related questions, horizontal tabs or sidebar navigation. Accordion behavior: single open (close others) or multiple open simultaneously. Question row: question text, expand/collapse icon with rotation animation, optional helpful count ("X found this helpful"). Answer content: rich text support (links, lists, code blocks, images), embed videos. Helpful voting: "Was this helpful?" Yes/No buttons, update count. Related questions: show related FAQs at bottom of answer. Deep linking: hash URLs to specific questions (#faq-payment), scroll and open on page load. Schema markup: FAQ structured data for SEO. CTA: "Still have questions? Contact us" at bottom. Lazy content: load answer content on expand for large FAQs. Print: expand all for print stylesheet. Feedback: if not helpful, show feedback form. Integration: link from other pages directly to relevant FAQ. Analytics: track which questions are opened most. Accessibility: proper disclosure pattern, aria-expanded, keyboard toggle, focus management.
